alibi_scope: ViT-B-only robustness plus separate ViT-S AMP training-collapse evidence; excluded from symmetric cross-architecture robustness metrics.

dispersion_effect.interpretation: Backbone reduction changes both mean adversarial robustness and seed dispersion in PE-dependent but differently ordered ways.

learned_q50_full_n6: NOT_ESTIMABLE: ViT-B q50 not bracketed for seeds 123, 456, 1011
main_interpretation: AMP-matched backbone scaling changes adversarial robustness in a PE-dependent way while random-noise nAUC remains nearly unchanged. The ViT-B Learned>RoPE ordering reverses to RoPE>Learned in ViT-S. This is not a universal scaling law and does not include matched ALiBi robustness.

normalized_nauc_above_one.interpretation: Allowed: perturbation-averaged normalized accuracy can marginally exceed 1 when noisy accuracy exceeds the clean reference on the fixed evaluation split.

sign_flip_quantisation.per_family_role: secondary directional-consistency evidence, not primary inference

welch_sensitivity.scope: supplementary sensitivity because seed labels are aligned but not strict training pairs
